draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of news summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to an unfiltered summarizer, across three news summarization benchmarks.
rationale: P1 (Varga & Sandoval) describes the salience pre-filtering method (scoring threshold, training data, application) but reports no 31% reduction figure and no number of benchmarks. The 31% figure appears only in the Methods summary as an unverified attribution ("often credited with... about 30%"), not in any cited passage. No statistical test or table supports it.

judgement.proposition: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported a 31% reduction in unsupported-entity summaries from salience pre-filtering across three benchmarks.
judgement.expressed_strength: "reported that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of news summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% ... across three news summarization benchmarks"
judgement.strongest_supported: The package does not support any version of this claim: P1 describes the filtering method only, with no reported reduction percentage or benchmark count.
